entities.name: Muhammad Abd El-Ghani El-Gamasy

entities.summary: Mohamed Abdel Ghani el-Gamasy was an Egyptian Field Marshal and the former minister of defense of Egypt. He is considered one of the architects of the Yom Kippur War.
